symptom: `mxcli widget sync --page ModW.PageD`, the qualified name the help asks for, matched nothing and printed 'No schema drift'; `--page PageD` worked but would also match a PageD in every other module. An applying run printed 'Read-only: nothing was written.' right before 'Applied: N property change(s)'
cause: PlanWidgetSync compared opts.Container with inst.UnitName, the bare document name, although the instance carried ModuleName; SyncWidgetPlan.Container, documented as the qualified name, was set to the bare name too, so two same-named pages in different modules printed and counted as one container. renderSyncPlan always ended with the read-only line and did not know whether it was a dry run
fix: --page matches Module.Name case-insensitively; a bare name is accepted when it names one document and refused, naming the matches, when it names documents in several modules (a sync writes); plan containers are qualified; the read-only line is printed only on --dry-run; usage is silenced for runtime errors
insight: A filter flag compared against a field the help does not describe fails silently as 'nothing to do': test the documented spelling, and a same-name page in a second module as the control for a bare-name match
